headline: Manbhawani Investment Limited Discloses Substantial Acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Manbhawani Investment Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE confirming a substantial acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure obligations under the SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.
detail: Manbhawani Investment Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The disclosure is the mandatory first step in the takeover code framework, requiring the acquirer to inform the exchange, the target company, and the public of the acquisition event. Depending on the shareholding percentage and whether specified thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.) are crossed, additional regulatory obligations-including an open offer to public shareholders-may be triggered. The filing indicates a material corporate event requiring investor and regulatory attention.
